blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—No ticket won the jackpots in the Grand Lotto 6/55 and MegaLotto 6/45 draws Wednesday, Sept. 30, according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office. The Grand Lotto 6/55 winning combination was 44-28-48-38-23-42 for a jackpot of ₱236.62 million. PCSO said there was no jackpot winner.
